breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: A highly contagious viral infection caused by the measles virus. Symptoms appear 8-12 days after exposure and include a rash, cough, fever and muscle pains that can last 4-7 days. Measles vaccines are available to provide prophylaxis, usually combined with mumps and rubella vaccines (MMR).
synonyms_en: Measles morbillivirus caused disease or disorder

top_drugs.drug_name: STREPTOCOCCUS PNEUMONIAE POLYSACCHARIDE CONJUGATED TO CORYNEBACTERIUM DIPHTHERIAE CRM197

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 人类已知传染性最强的病毒之一（R0可达12–18）；虽多数儿童可康复，但未免疫婴幼儿与营养不良者易并发重症麻疹肺炎、喉炎梗阻或急性脑炎（数日内致死），极少数多年后还可诱发致命性亚急性硬化性全脑炎（SSPE）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 尚无特效抗麻疹病毒药物，依靠对症支持、补充维生素A及防治继发细菌性肺炎即可使绝大多数患者临床恢复；接种2剂次含麻疹成分疫苗（MMR）可提供约97%终生保护。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO/CDC联合报告显示2023–2024年全球每年约1,030万–1,100万例麻疹感染，造成约95,000例死亡（主要为5岁以下未接种疫苗儿童）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 得益于高达95%以上的麻腮风（MMR）两剂次接种率，中国已将麻疹发病率压低至极低水平（接近消除标准，年报告死亡极罕见，偶见未到接种月龄婴儿或境外输入引起局部散发）。
annual_deaths_china.source: 中国CDC免疫规划与麻疹监测报告

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 2024年全球约1,100万例感染，因疫苗覆盖率停滞（MCV1约84%、MCV2约76%），59个国家报告大型暴发。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：麻疹患儿高热出疹期间若出现呼吸急促、鼻翼扇动、三凹征（重症肺炎）、犬吠样咳嗽伴吸气性喘鸣（急性喉炎气道梗阻），或突发抽搐、昏迷（麻疹脑炎），立即拨打120！严禁迷信“捂汗发疹”（高热捂汗极易诱发高热惊厥与休克），严禁带患儿去普通人群密集诊所候诊交叉传染；需电话联系医院发热门诊走隔离通道，立即吸氧、退热及抗继发细菌感染。

master.definition_en: Also known as carcinoma in situ of the urinary bladder or high grade intraurothelial neoplasia, this is a flat lesion of the transitional cell epithelium characterized by severe cytologic atypia. This lesion is confined to the urothelium, and is a precursor of invasive transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder. Stage 0is includes: Tis, N0, M0. Tis: Carcinoma in situ: "flat tumor". N0: No regional lymph node metastasis. M0: No distant metastasis. (AJCC 6th and 7th eds.)

master.definition_en: A thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of expanded areas which resemble the normal thymic cortex. The neoplastic epithelial cells are small and scant and there is a dense T-lymphocytic component present. Areas of medullary differentiation with or without Hassall's corpuscles are also present. It may be associated with myasthenia gravis, pure red cell aplasia, and hypogammaglobulinemia. It has a low grade malignant potential. The majority of cases occur in the anterior mediastinum as Masaoka stage I tumors. A minority of the cases occur as stage II tumors.

master.definition_en: A chronic, systemic autoimmune disorder characterized by inflammation in the synovial membranes and articular surfaces. It manifests primarily as a symmetric, erosive polyarthritis that spares the axial skeleton and is typically associated with the presence in the serum of rheumatoid factor.

curated.category: 风湿免疫与系统性血管炎
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 以对称性外周小关节持续滑膜炎和骨侵蚀为特征的自身免疫病，可在数年内造成关节畸形致残与劳动力丧失；同时长期慢性全身炎症与激素应用可引发类风湿相关间质性肺病（RA-ILD）、血管炎及加速性冠心病心衰，显著缩短患者寿命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 尚无停药根治疗法，但坚持“早期达标治疗（T2T）”，在起病3-6个月窗口期内以甲氨蝶呤为锚定药，联合来氟米特或升级TNF-α抑制剂、IL-6R拮抗剂（托珠单抗）或口服JAK抑制剂（托法替布/巴瑞替尼/乌帕替尼），可使绝大多数患者实现临床缓解、彻底阻止骨破坏致残。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算全球类风湿关节炎直接归因年死亡约37,300-38,300例（不同年龄截断报告微差，另有大量归因心血管及肺间质死亡）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021显示1990-2021年中国RA年龄标化死亡率大幅下降约22%-26.23%，但由于人口老龄化致绝对患病和相关老年死亡仍高企（相关文献未单列精确绝对死亡数字）

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021估算全球约1,760万例类风湿关节炎患者（标化患病率约208.8/10万人），预计到2050年将攀升至约3,170万例，女性为男性2.5-3倍。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国RA患病率约为0.2%-0.42%，估算全国患者总数超过500万例，女性占70%-80%，平均发病年龄约为45岁，总体规范达标控制率长期远低于西方。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 高选择性JAK1抑制剂（乌帕替尼、中国1类艾玛昔替尼等）及丰富国产阿达木/托珠/依那西普生物类似药大幅破除了高值靶向药价格壁垒；2) “难治性（D2T）类风湿关节炎”领域正开展CD19/BCMA双靶点CAR-T及双特异性T细胞衔接器（如Blinatumomab等探索）尝试清除滑膜组织深层致病B细胞；3) 抗瓜氨酸化蛋白抗体阳性（ACPA+）高危人群应用阿巴西普（Abatacept）进行临床前预防性阻断发病研究取得重要进展。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 我国尤其是农村基层存在大量“偏方草药止痛”替代规范DMARDs治疗、确诊时已严重骨畸形致残现象，早期规范达标率仍不足；2) 约15%-20%多线靶向耐药的“难治性RA”急需新机理机制药物；3) 合并RA相关间质性肺病（UIP型）的治疗尚缺乏既能强效护关节又不加重肺纤维化或肺感染的安全指南标准方案。

master.definition_en: Scalp-ear-nipple syndrome is characterized by the following triad: areas of hairless raw skin over the scalp (present at birth and healing during childhood), prominent, hypoplastic ears with almost absent pinnae, and bilateral amastia. Thirty cases have been described so far. Renal and urinary tract abnormalities, as well as cataract, have also been observed. Transmission is autosomal dominant.
synonyms_en: hereditary syndrome of lumpy scalp, odd ears and rudimentary nipples

master.definition_en: Dandy-Walker malformation (DWM) is the association of three signs: hydrocephalus, partial or complete absence of the cerebellar vermis, and posterior fossa cyst contiguous with the fourth ventricle, presenting early in life with hydrocephalus, bulging occiput and posterior fossa signs such as cranial nerve palsies, nystagmus and ataxia.
synonyms_en: Dandy-Walker syndrome or malformation (type of DW complex)
mega cisterna magna (type of DW complex)
mondo_categories: cystic malformation of the posterior fossa

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Infundibulopelvic stenosis-multicystic kidney syndrome is a rare, genetic renal malformation syndrome characterized by variable degrees of malformation in the pelvicalyceal system (including unilateral or bilateral calyceal dilatation, infundibular stenosis, hypoplasia or stenosis of the renal pelvis) which lead to multicystic kidney. Clinically it exhibits abdominal, lumbar or flank pain, recurrent urinary tract infections, hypertension, proteinuria and often progresses to renal insufficiency. Calyceal dilatation and hydronephrosis are frequently seen on imaging.

master.definition_en: Enthesitis-related juvenile idiopathic arthritis is a subtype of juvenile idiopathic arthritis that is characterized by both arthritis and inflammation of an enthesitis site (the point at which a ligament, tendon, or joint capsule attaches to the bone). Signs and symptoms generally develop in late childhood or early adolescence and include pain, tenderness, and swelling in joints and at the enthesis. The knee and the back of the ankle (at the Achilles tendon) are the most commonly affected parts of the body. The underlying cause of enthesitis-related juvenile idiopathic arthritis is currently unknown (idiopathic). It is very rare for more than one member of a family to have juvenile arthritis; however, research suggests that having a family member with juvenile arthritis or any autoimmune disease may increase the risk of having juvenile arthritis, in general. Treatment usually involves different types of medications to help manage symptoms and/or physical therapy.
